name: Swiftly
source: Single source of truth for the design tokens. Edit here, run `cargo run -p swiftly-design --bin gen_tokens -- --semantic`; never edit the generated Swift, Kotlin or Rust files. Values are what the apps use today; the iPhone value is the base, desktop and tv override it.

sets.touch: iPhone, iPad, Android phone and tablet
sets.tv: Apple TV (tvOS points); Android TV uses half of every tv value in dp

colors.name: surface.base
colors.use: Page background of every screen; gradients run out into this colour.
colors.avoid: Cards or controls: those sit one level up.

colors.name: surface.group
colors.use: Settings groups and cards that lie directly on surface.base.

colors.name: surface.control
colors.use: Anything you can touch: buttons, fields, chips, sheets, desktop sidebar.

colors.name: surface.raised
colors.use: What lies on a control: active chip, hover on a control, hint strip.
colors.avoid: As the main surface of a page (too faint at 3 m).

colors.name: surface.pressed
colors.use: Pressed secondary button (touch).

colors.name: surface.selected
colors.use: Selected or playing row.
colors.avoid: Accent-coloured fills: the selected state stays neutral, the accent sits in the glyph.

colors.name: surface.translucent
colors.use: Buttons and highlighted rows over image colour: picks up the colour beneath.
colors.avoid: On a flat page without image colour (use surface.control).

colors.name: surface.hover
colors.use: Pointer hover and keyboard-focus surface on desktop.

colors.name: surface.focus
colors.use: TV focus surface on rows and chips, readable at 3 m.

colors.name: surface.overlay
colors.use: Dimming layer behind a modal overlay.
colors.avoid: As a card or control surface. Not yet used by name in app code (design-file colour `shade`); adopt when the next overlay is built.

colors.name: surface.mark
colors.use: Plate under the service marks.

colors.name: text.primary
colors.use: Everything that is read, icons, text on translucent surfaces.
colors.avoid: Hints and metadata (use secondary or tertiary).

colors.name: text.secondary
colors.use: Running text, values, descriptions.
colors.avoid: Replacing it with white 80%: opacity changes its look on image colour.

colors.name: text.tertiary
colors.use: Third line, placeholders, shortcuts, group titles, disabled text.
colors.avoid: Anything the user must read to act.

colors.name: text.on-accent
colors.use: Text on an accent surface.

colors.name: accent.selection
colors.use: State only: chosen, progress, links, Direct Play proof. Default of the Look; a Look may replace it at runtime.

colors.name: accent.selection-light
colors.use: Selected filter chip while focused, TV only.

colors.name: accent.selection-quiet
colors.use: Surface under accent text: Direct Play chip.

colors.name: border.hairline
colors.use: Separator between rows; alpha because it also lies over posters.

colors.name: border.edge
colors.use: 1 pt edge of panels and menus; toggle track when off.

colors.name: border.tile
colors.use: Hairline around a tile in the look picker.

colors.name: state.warning
colors.use: Something waits for someone.

colors.name: state.error
colors.use: Something went wrong.

colors.name: state.focus-fill
colors.use: TV: the one focused thing (buttons, tabs, keys, player icons), dark text on it.

colors.name: scrim.button
colors.use: Dark round button over an image.

colors.name: scrim.glass
colors.use: Quiet glass behind the player bar buttons.
colors.avoid: Anywhere without a material under it.

colors.name: scrim.glass-edge
colors.use: Hairline on the quiet glass.

colors.name: ring.track
colors.use: Light track of the download ring.

colors.name: ring.progress
colors.use: Progress ring on episode cards.

colors.name: badge.resolution
colors.use: Resolution badge.

colors.name: badge.range
colors.use: Dynamic range badge.

colors.name: badge.video
colors.use: Video codec badge.

colors.name: badge.audio
colors.use: Audio badge.

type.name: title.detail
type.use: Desktop film and series title over the wide hero.
type.avoid: Phones (they use a logo or title.large).

type.name: heading.section
type.use: Rail titles on Start, group titles.

type.name: label.tile-focused
type.use: Tile caption while focused on TV.

type.name: caption.small
type.avoid: Anything the user must act on.

layout.name: space.page-wide
layout.use: Page margin on wide touch layouts (tablet).

layout.name: space.content-top
layout.use: Desktop content start under the toolbar; TV under the top bar.

layout.name: space.sidebar-top
layout.use: Gap between the top edge of the desktop sidebar (the window buttons area on the Mac) and the first sidebar row; no wordmark above it. 52 is the macOS standard unified-toolbar band: measured on macOS 26 with a headless NSWindow (unified toolbar, hidden title), the window buttons sit 19 to 33 pt from the top, centred in that 52 pt band (size.toolbar-height), and the first row starts at its lower edge, 19 pt under the buttons like the 19 pt above them, as the first row does in Music and TV. For comparison, a standard NSSplitViewController sidebar reports a top safe area of 42 pt without a toolbar and 66 pt with a unified toolbar, whose own control row is part of that 66.
layout.avoid: Space above the page title in the content (space.content-top); touch and TV.

layout.name: space.tile-gap
layout.use: Gap between tiles in a row or grid.

layout.name: space.value-gap
layout.use: Gap between a value and its rail.

layout.name: space.grid-row
layout.use: Vertical gap in a poster grid.

layout.name: space.block-gap
layout.use: Gap between blocks on the detail page.

layout.name: space.settings-columns
layout.use: Gap between the two settings columns on TV.

layout.name: space.row-pad-v
layout.use: Padding above and below the content of every settings row (row.settings); a two-line row grows to about 66.
layout.avoid: Media rows, tiles, fixed row heights.

layout.name: space.row-pad-h
layout.use: Padding left and right inside a settings card (row.settings).

layout.name: radius.panel
layout.use: Desktop popups and episode/setting rows (menus use radius.menu).

layout.name: radius.sheet
layout.use: Sheets from the bottom: screen corner radius minus 8 (iPhone with island 47; per device in radius.screen); the value here is the iPhone one.

layout.name: radius.button
layout.use: Text buttons on touch screens and the Mac detail page (Play, Continue, Download): rounded rectangle, never a capsule. Same value as the `radius.button` entry of the radius scale.

layout.name: size.row-height
layout.use: Minimum height of a list row (one line). Rows grow with their content: padding 14 above and below, so a title + subtitle row is about 66 (rows must breathe, same everywhere).
layout.avoid: Fixed heights that squeeze two-line rows.

layout.name: size.button-progress
layout.use: Watched line inside the bottom edge of the detail page's main button (accent on a dark track, clipped by the button corner).

layout.name: size.sidebar-row-height
layout.use: Height of a sidebar row on the Mac (icon, label, shortcut; corner radius.small, selected row accent at 12 %).

layout.name: size.hero-play-height
layout.use: Height of the main Play / Continue button in the desktop detail hero (light fill, radius.button).

layout.name: size.hero-play-width
layout.use: Minimum width of the main Play / Continue button in the desktop detail hero.

layout.name: size.tab-height
layout.use: Height of a top tab on TV (the tab frame); the focus pill and the underline sit inside it.

layout.name: size.tab-pill-height
layout.use: Height of the white focus pill behind a top tab label on TV, centred in the tab frame.

layout.name: size.tab-underline-height
layout.use: Accent line under the open top tab on TV, as wide as the label, directly below the pill; shown only while that tab is not focused.

layout.name: space.tab-pad-h
layout.use: Padding left and right of a top tab label on TV (the pill is the label plus this on each side).

layout.name: space.tab-gap
layout.use: Gap between two top tabs on TV.

layout.name: size.sidebar-width
layout.use: Width of the desktop sidebar (Mac prototype: wordmark, section rows, Meins, profile row).

layout.name: size.toolbar-height
layout.use: Height of the desktop toolbar above the content (back/forward arrows, title after scrolling).
layout.avoid: Touch navigation bars; the player bar.

motion.name: motion.instant
motion.use: Press down: the finger gets no delay.

motion.name: motion.section
motion.use: Switching a top-level section on touch: arrives from 0.995.
motion.avoid: Scale below 0.99: the edge becomes visible.

motion.name: motion.emphasized
motion.use: Sheets sliding in from the bottom (drawer curve; a drag releases with the finger's velocity).

motion.name: motion.reduced
motion.use: Replaces every movement under Reduce Motion.

motion.name: motion.push
motion.use: Desktop push: page below moves -30% and dims.

motion.name: motion.backdrop
motion.use: TV backdrop fade in; ambient colour never before the picture.

motion.name: motion.controls-fade
motion.use: TV player controls fade; they hide after 8 s while playing.

motion.name: motion.press
motion.use: Press feedback on buttons: scale to 0.97 and back.
motion.avoid: Full-width rows (they dim, they do not shrink).

motion.name: motion.sheet
motion.use: Sheet and dialog appearing; touch drags follow the finger 1:1 and release with a spring (motion.emphasized).

shadows.name: shadow.card
shadows.use: Episode card over the player; colour, blur and offset scale with how far it rests.

shadows.name: shadow.lift
shadows.use: TV focus lift, only while focused.

state.name: state.pressed-scale
state.avoid: Full-width rows: they dim, they do not shrink.

state.name: state.pressed-opacity
state.use: Opacity while pressed: 1.0, the press changes scale only.
state.avoid: Dimming buttons; full-width rows dim by surface instead.

state.name: state.hover-scale
state.use: Tile picture on pointer hover, no ring.

state.name: state.disabled-opacity
state.use: Disabled form buttons; nav arrows use 0.35.

state.name: state.focus-scale
state.use: TV focus scale for tiles, buttons, tabs, chips (1.10 small icons, 1.03 wide rows).

components.name: button.primary
components.summary: The one filled action of a page or sheet: white surface, dark text (Abspielen, Anmelden).
components.use: One per screen or sheet: the action the screen exists for.
components.avoid: Second actions (button.secondary). Never an accent fill: the accent carries state only.

states.pressed: fill at 75%, scale 0.97, no delay in, quick out
states.disabled: surface.control fill, text.tertiary label (dimmed, not translucent)

deviations: Swift draws the fill as Color.white and the pressed fill as white 75%; no token names the primary fill or its pressed state yet.
Swift label is an inline 17 pt semibold; label.button is 15 pt.
Rust press_button uses a 999 radius, the others radius.control (10).

components.name: button.secondary
components.summary: Neutral action next to or below the primary one (Abbrechen, Schnellverbindung).
components.use: Second way to a goal, or any action that is not the page's main one.
props: accent (label in accent.selection, e.g. Quick Connect)
deviations: Rust press_button fills the secondary with surface.selected (white 8%), Swift and Kotlin use surface.control.

components.name: button.quiet
components.summary: Text-only action in the accent, no surface (second action of an empty state or error notice).
components.use: A low-weight second action under an empty state or an error.
components.avoid: Anything that must be found at a glance.
components.swift: PressText ButtonStyle (Sources/Shared/Style.swift:106), used as a style, no named view
deviations: Only Kotlin has a named component; Swift and Rust build it ad hoc.

components.name: button.press
components.summary: Press feedback for every other tappable thing: icon buttons, rows, text (scale 0.97 or dim, no layout change).
components.use: As the ButtonStyle of any tappable that is not one of the named buttons.
components.avoid: Full-width rows: they dim, they do not shrink (PressRow).
props: variant: button (scale + opacity), row (dim only), text

states.pressed: button: scale 0.97 and opacity 0.85 (TV opacity 1); row: dim

components.name: button.icon
components.summary: Round or square icon-only button, often dark over an image (back, close, more).
components.use: One glyph, no label, over a picture or a bar.
components.avoid: Text actions; targets under 44 pt on touch.
deviations: No shared icon-button type on any platform: each screen draws its own plate and size.

components.name: button.tv
components.summary: TV button: focus fills it white with dark text, small lift.
components.use: Every button on tvOS and Android TV.

components.name: card.poster
components.summary: Poster tile: picture 2:3, title and second line below, optional progress and badge.
components.use: Any title in a rail or grid with a portrait picture.
components.avoid: Landscape pictures (card.landscape). No edge or shadow: content tiles carry neither.
deviations: Rust poster_tile strokes the tile with border.tile; the token is for the look picker only, content tiles have no edge.

components.name: card.landscape
components.summary: Landscape tile 16:9: continue-watching, episodes, extras.
components.use: Pictures that are wider than tall; the continue-watching rail.
components.kotlin: TileView landscape = true (Android/phone/src/main/java/de/paulherter/swiftly/StartPage.kt:381); ExtraTile (Android/phone/src/main/java/de/paulherter/swiftly/TitlePage.kt:711); TvTile landscape (Android/phone/src/main/java/de/paulherter/swiftly/tv/TvStyle.kt:738)

components.name: tile.placeholder
components.summary: Grey placeholder while pictures and rails load (shimmer-free).
components.use: Loading state of every tile, rail and grid.

states.loading: surface.control block with the tile corner

components.swift: TilePlaceholder, GridPlaceholder, RailsPlaceholder, LoadField (Sources/Shared/Style.swift:4878-4944); tvOS (Sources/tvOS/TVComponents.swift:1753,1788); macOS (Sources/macOS/MacComponents.swift:514-572)

components.name: rail.horizontal
components.summary: Titled horizontal rail of tiles that scrolls sideways and keeps the page margin.
components.use: Home, collections, cast, seasons: any row of tiles.

states.focused: TV: focus moves tile to tile, remembered per rail

components.name: rail.value
components.summary: Horizontal strip of value pills / chips under a header; fades with scroll.
components.use: Filters and quick values at the top of a page.

components.name: rail.alphabet
components.summary: Letter index at the screen edge for long lists.
components.use: Long alphabetical lists such as the library.

components.name: chip.filter
components.summary: Capsule filter or choice chip (genre, sort, language).
components.use: Choose one of a few values or open a small menu.

states.selected: touch: accent fill, dark text; desktop: surface.raised, text.primary
states.focused: TV: surface.focus, selected + focused uses accent.selection-light

deviations: Rust popup_chip hard-codes height 30, radius 15 and the 13/600 font instead of size.chip-height, radius.pill and the type token.
Android has three private chip implementations (GenrePage, PlayerMenus, ManagementAdmin).

components.name: pill.value
components.summary: Small capsule with a glyph and a value (Abspielen, sort order, season).
components.use: A single action or value that is not a filter.
deviations: Rust TV value_pill rests on a raw white 10% fill (Color::new(1,1,1,0.10)) and radius 999 literal; no token names that 10%.
Rust desktop value_pill uses radius 15.0 literal instead of radius.pill.

components.name: pill.offering
components.summary: Skip intro / next episode pill over the player.
components.use: Time-bound player offers (Intro überspringen, Nächste Folge).

components.name: badge.tile
components.summary: Corner badge on a tile: watched check or unwatched count.
components.use: Watch state on poster and landscape tiles.
deviations: Swift draws the plate as Theme.reason.opacity(0.78): the 78% alpha is a raw value.

components.name: badge.tech
components.summary: Colour-coded technical badge (resolution, dynamic range, video codec, audio).
components.use: Quality facts in downloads and the player proof line.
deviations: No Swift component on iOS or tvOS; no Rust component.

components.name: badge.request
components.summary: Capsule that names the state of a request (verfügbar, wartet, abgelehnt).
components.use: Seerr request and issue states.

components.name: card.group
components.summary: Rounded surface that holds settings rows (a group).
components.use: Settings groups and cards that lie directly on the page.
components.avoid: A card inside a card; tiles.
deviations: Swift CardView uses radius.card; the token doc names radius.area for settings groups. Equal on touch (16), different on desktop (14 vs 16).

components.name: row.settings
components.summary: Min height 60 (size.row-height), padding 14 above and below, 18 left/right inside the card; a title + subtitle row grows to about 66
components.use: Every row of a settings group, profile page and picker.
components.swift: ProfileRow (Sources/Shared/Style.swift:3743); RowsLayout, ChoiceRow, ValueRow (Sources/Shared/PlaybackSettingsView.swift:252,290,342); ToggleRow, ValuesRow (Sources/macOS/SettingRows.swift:148,195); ActionRow, ToggleRow, RowsStyle (Sources/tvOS/ProfileView.swift:916,984,1288; Sources/tvOS/TVComponents.swift:386)
components.kotlin: RowsLayout, ChoiceRow, ValueRow, ProfileRow (Android/phone/src/main/java/de/paulherter/swiftly/Settings.kt:424,455,466,490); TvRow, TvSettingsRow (Android/phone/src/main/java/de/paulherter/swiftly/tv/TvStyle.kt:673,926)

components.name: toggle.switch
components.summary: On/off switch with a white thumb.
components.use: A setting that is either on or off and takes effect at once.
deviations: Swift ToggleSwitch sizes the track 46x28 with literals; no size token.

components.name: field.input
components.summary: Text field: surface.control, one line, clear button.
components.use: Any single-line entry (address, name, search).

components.name: sheet.standard
components.summary: Bottom sheet (centred card on wide layouts) with title, lines and a cancel row.
components.use: Choices and confirmations that interrupt the page briefly.

states.open: surface.control card over a dimmed page

tokens.surface.overlay: dim layer (token exists, code still uses black)

components.swift: SheetModifier, SheetCategory, SheetLine, SheetCancel, ActionSheet (Sources/Shared/Style.swift:4047,4283,4379,4386,4414); SheetLine (Sources/macOS/Style.swift:453)
deviations: surface.overlay is not used by name yet; the dim layer is a raw black.

components.name: menu.player
components.summary: Player menu layer: audio, subtitles, speed, episodes.
components.use: Choices while a title plays.

states.focused: TV: surface.focus, state.focus-fill on the key

components.name: bar.player
components.summary: Glass capsule with the player's bar buttons.
components.use: Controls over the picture while a title plays.
components.avoid: Anything without a material under it.

components.name: bar.tab
components.summary: Navigation between sections: bottom bar (touch), sidebar (desktop), top tabs (TV).
components.use: The top-level sections only.

states.selected: touch: text.primary; desktop: surface.selected row; TV: state.focus-fill on focus

components.swift: NavBar, SectionButton (Sources/Shared/Style.swift:2236,2150); Sidebar (Sources/Shared/Style.swift:2641); SidebarRow (Sources/macOS/MacComponents.swift:17); TabStyle, HeaderBar (Sources/tvOS/TVComponents.swift:165,614)

components.name: header.subpage
components.summary: Subpage header: back button, centred title.
components.use: Every pushed page.

states.scrolled: blurred bar fades in under it

components.name: header.detail
components.summary: Detail header: hero picture, title, proof line and action buttons.
components.use: The top of a movie, show or person page.

components.name: toast.hint
components.summary: Short message strip at the bottom of the screen; closes itself after 3 to 6 s and is announced to VoiceOver.
components.use: Confirmation or a refused action that needs no decision.
components.avoid: Errors that block the page (empty.state); anything with a button.

states.dismissed: fades with motion.standard after min 3 s, max 6 s

deviations: Swift HintStrip fills with surface.control; the token doc names surface.raised for the hint strip.
Rust has the text state but no named component.

components.name: banner.arrival
components.summary: Card for a request that has arrived: poster, line, play button and close; several stack.
components.use: A title the user requested is available now.
deviations: Swift darkens stacked cards with a raw black at 10% per depth.

components.name: empty.state
components.summary: Empty or failed page: disc with glyph, headline, text, optional button.
components.use: No results, no connection, nothing downloaded.

states.loading: disc at 45% while the request runs
states.error: same layout with the error wording

local_sizes.disc: 78 dp (Theme.circleEmpty); Style.kt also has emptyDisc 120 dp

components.name: progress.bar
components.summary: Thin progress bar on tiles and rows.
components.use: Watched share on a tile or row.
deviations: Swift ProgressBar draws the track as a raw Color.white 30%; the same value exists only as ring.track, which is meant for the download ring.

components.name: progress.ring
components.summary: Ring for downloads and countdowns.
components.use: Download state in a row; countdown to the next episode.
props: state (none | waits | running | paused | done | failed)

components.name: spinner.loading
components.summary: Indeterminate loader.
components.use: Work with no known length.
deviations: Swift and Kotlin use different default colours (text.primary vs text.tertiary).

components.name: slider.time
components.summary: Player seek bar with time labels.
components.use: Seeking in a title.
deviations: Colours of track and thumb were not checked against tokens; entry lists intent from DESIGN.md.

components.name: row.media
components.summary: Row with a picture: episode, file, download.
components.use: Lists of playable or downloadable things.

components.name: card.episode
components.summary: Episode card over the player picture (cards stack and rest at different depths).
components.use: Episode list inside the player.

components.name: swipe.row
components.summary: Row that reveals an action when swiped sideways (touch).
components.use: Quick row actions on touch (Entfernen).
components.avoid: Desktop and TV (use the tile menu).

components.name: focus.tv
components.summary: Shared TV focus treatment: scale, white fill or surface, small lift.
components.use: Every focusable thing on TV.

states.focused: scale 1.06 (1.10 small icons, 1.03 wide rows), shadow.lift, fill by role
